headline: As of 2026-10-15: 6,113,435 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 37 of 50 states, D+21.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 6,113,435 early/mail ballots cast so far across 37 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+21.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (768,785), Florida (727,892), Virginia (604,369).
